question: If people get tired of approving every AI action, should machines check each other instead?
reflection: Knowing where human attention fails can help us design systems that protect people instead of blaming them.

one_line: A reported study found that people miss most risky AI commands they are asked to approve, so labs are moving checks to automated reviewers.

top_stories.title: Humans tire of approving AI actions
top_stories.what: Anthropic reports that testers caught only about one in seven dangerous commands, falling further after many prompts, while an automatic checker caught about nine in ten.
top_stories.why: This is a clear behavioural finding on approval fatigue that matters for any human-in-the-loop design.

top_stories.title: OpenAI pauses work on a risky model
top_stories.what: OpenAI rated its upcoming Astra model at its highest cyber risk level, partly paused internal work and brought in outside testers.
top_stories.why: It shows safety frameworks starting to change release plans, which regulators will watch.

top_stories.title: Coding sessions that message each other
top_stories.what: Claude Code now lets separate sessions on one computer send short summaries to each other, without sharing full chats.
top_stories.why: Coordinated agents can split large tasks, but each handoff needs a clear record.

saudi_lens.text: Saudi cybersecurity bodies may want to track how labs rate and hold back models with strong hacking skills, as this affects critical infrastructure.

idea.title: Approval fatigue study
idea.pitch: Measure how quickly staff stop reading AI approval requests in a real workflow and test designs that keep attention high.
idea.first_step: Log approval clicks and decision times for one team over a week.

idea_kids.title: Spot the odd one
idea_kids.pitch: A card game where children check a long line of cards for the one wrong card, and notice how attention drops as the line gets longer.
idea_kids.first_step: Make 40 picture cards with three hidden odd ones.

terms.definition: When people asked to approve many requests stop reading them carefully and click yes by habit.
